messages:
sam: Heads-up — I need to hold PR #18902 landing. CI quota is tight in us-west and the scheduled rebase window opens at 02:00 UTC. If we try to land now we might trigger the deploy freeze fallback. Can we get eyes and either prioritize CI or move to the rebase window?

aria: ETA on the quota? is it a per-pool throttling issue or the whole CI account?

sam: Looks like per-pool in us-west-gpu. Queue length 18 for gpu-heavy tests. Non-blocking unit tests pass.

ci-bot: [CI STATUS] PR #18902: queued on us-west-gpu (pos 18). Estimated start ~45m. Rerun request accepted, but will be queued. See: https://ci.internal/18902

jordan: can we run a partial matrix to unblock merge? e.g., skip slow perf tests and land behind a canary?

sam: I thought about a canary but there's a deploy blackout window starting 03:15 UTC for infra maintenance. If the canary overlaps the blackout we risk rollbacks.

lee: if we rebase into the 02:00-03:00 window we should be fine. Is that the scheduled rebase you mentioned?

sam: yes — 02:00-02:45 UTC is the DB migration-friendly rebase slot. If we rebase now and land during that slot CI will run in lower-traffic lane. But need a quick +1 and a fast CI run.

aria: i can take a look and give a quick review in 15. If sam rebases to main and force-pushes, can ci-bot prioritize?

ci-bot: [PR PRIORITY] Request to prioritize PR #18902 received from @aria. Current queue adjustments are manual. @eng-releases: please confirm to ops for temporary priority.

sam: tagging @ops for a manual bump. ops, can you temporarily bump this PR into the low-latency lane for one run? Will revert after landing.

jordan: one caveat — the PR touches runtime batching; if anything flaky surfaces it could extend the window. Are we comfortable doing an on-call watch during the canary?

lee: I can keep eyes for the 02:00 slot. If we see perf regressions we abort and rollback.

ops: noted. We can give one priority run to PR #18902 at 02:05 UTC. Please ensure the PR is rebased to main and CI job tags `priority:canary` before that time.

sam: plan: 01:50 UTC — rebase and push. 02:05 UTC — priority CI run. 02:20 UTC — if green, land and monitor. If any test fails, abort and coordinate rollback.

aria: sounds good. I'll review now and ping when done.

ci-bot: [CI UPDATE] PR #18902: prioritized run scheduled at 02:05 UTC. Current queue position: 1 (priority lane).

sam: thanks — will rebase at :git: 01:50 and ping here.

aria: quick note on rebase: use `git rebase -i main` and squash the fixup commits, CI handles new history fine.

jordan: also add a short rollout note in the PR description: mention the canary lane and who is on-call (lee). Helps support triage if we get alerts.

sam: done — PR description updated with rollout note and on-call. pinging @ops when rebased.

lee: i've added a Grafana dashboard link to the PR for quick latency checks.

sam: rebased and force-pushed at 01:52 UTC. tagging @aria for final glance.

aria: looksgood, approving now. +1

ci-bot: [CI] PR #18902: prioritized job started at 02:06 UTC. Tests running: unit, integration (short), smoke.

ci-bot: [CI] PR #18902: all prioritized tests passed at 02:18 UTC.

sam: landing now. merging in 30s.

ci-bot: [MERGE] PR #18902: merged to main at 02:21 UTC by sam. Canary monitor started.

lee: watching metrics — no spike so far. will report in 15.

jordan: great job coordinating. let's de-prioritize once rollout is stable.

ops: priority lane reverted. Thanks everyone. :tada:
